title: consolida orientalis subsp. hispanica
intro: Consolida orientalis subsp. hispanica, commonly known as Rocket Larkspur, is a flowering plant species used in traditional medicine. This plant has been associated with several health benefits, including its use as an anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic agent, which can aid in reducing pain and muscle spasms. The therapeutic actions of Consolida orientalis subsp. hispanica include sedation, analgesia, and relaxation, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to confirm its full range of bioactive compounds.
